aiCoach.tooltip: AI answers questions, explains the method and reviews; it never writes the document for you.

aiCoach.reviewPrompt: Review my draft of the {{subject}}. Quote my own words, say what works and what is missing, and back it with customer feedback. Do not rewrite it for me.

categoriesManager.aiDescription: Describe your company, industry, or product to get AI-suggested categories tailored to your business.
categoriesManager.aiPlaceholder: e.g., We are an airline company offering domestic and international flights. Our customers care about punctuality, comfort, baggage handling, customer service, and in-flight experience...
categoriesManager.generateError: Failed to generate categories. Please try again.
categoriesManager.emptyHint: Use AI generation above or add categories manually below.
categoriesManager.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this category and all its subcategories? This action cannot be undone.
categoriesManager.listHelp: Each category has an id stored on every review, a description, the product it belongs to, and its product owners. Owners automatically see their categories' feedback and are the people who act on it.
categoriesManager.saveError: The categories could not be saved. Check the names and limits, and that you are an administrator.

details.productHint: The product or area this category belongs to.

details.ownersHint: Owners automatically see this category's feedback.

reprocess.title: Reprocess existing feedback
reprocess.description: After changing categories, re-categorise the reviews already stored. Reviews are updated in place — nothing is deleted.

processed.title: Re-categorise processed reviews
processed.description: Classifies the stored (translated) text against the current categories. Only category and subcategory change.

raw.title: Reprocess from raw data
raw.description: Re-runs the full enrichment (sentiment, category, persona, problem analysis) from the original raw data.

dimensions.title: Re-infer dimensions
dimensions.description: Re-runs the model for the dimensions it may infer. Values set by the source, its profile or a person are never changed.

reprocess.alreadyRunning: A reprocess job is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
reprocess.stoppedAtCeiling: Stopped at the per-job limit of {{max}} reviews to cap model costs — the remaining reviews were not reprocessed. Narrow the window to cover them.
reprocess.startError: The reprocess job could not be started.
reprocess.daysHint: 1–{{max, number}} days, or 0 for all time. Manual corrections are kept unless you choose otherwise.
reprocess.costNote: Cost: one model call per review in the window. An all-time run over a large data lake can take hours.
reprocess.confirmMessage: {{mode}} for {{window}}. This makes one model call per review in that window. Reviews are updated in place; nothing is deleted.
